app_summary: An online shop selling astronomy products, based on the OpenTelemetry Demo. It is built with polyglot microservices (Go, Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Rust, ...) communicating via gRPC and HTTP behind an Envoy frontend-proxy, with Kafka for asynchronous order processing and Valkey as cart store. Supported Operations: View product catalog, Receive product recommendations and ads, Add item to cart, Checkout with selected items, Currency conversion, Process payment, Generate shipping quotes, Send order confirmation emails

rca_analyses_list.diagnosis: The payment service is failing when performing a metadata lookup: the Node.js process logged “MetadataLookupWarning: received unexpected error = All promises were rejected code = UNKNOWN”, which indicates the service could not obtain required payment metadata and all async requests to the payment provider/metadata endpoint failed. This prevented the payment service from completing payment operations and caused higher-level checkout/payment flows to fail.

evaluation.rca_motivation: Ground truth is about Kafka ‘orders’ topic overload from duplicate producer messages and slow consumers causing lag; the agent instead blames a payment service metadata lookup failure and async request errors. This is a different component, different failure mode, and unrelated mechanism, so the analysis is essentially irrelevant to the actual incident.
